question: What happens to those who had knowledge and discernment but turn to lower abodes at death?
premises: Some practitioners have attained knowledge and discernment.
Near death they may place their faith in lower abodes.
That final orientation leads to obscuration.
inference: Even previously attained knowledge can be obscured if one turns toward lower abodes at the moment of death.
uncertainties: adharāyataneṣu may refer to lower doctrinal levels, lower deities, or lower post-death destinations.
plain_english: Those who had gained knowledge and discernment, but near death take refuge in lower abodes, become veiled there.
